summary.title: Phishing Awareness Simulator - STRIDE threat model
summary.description: Threat model of the Eduvos phishing-awareness simulator (Firebase Hosting, Python Cloud Functions, Firestore). Framework: STRIDE on a data-flow diagram, with CIA impact. Scope is the simulator and study environment, not live campus email or identity systems. Open this file in OWASP Threat Dragon 2.x.

Participant
data.description: Unauthenticated learner using a tokenised campaign link or the public quiz.

threats.title: Stolen assignment token used as participant
threats.description: Anyone who obtains a campaign link can open the scenario and record events. The token is the participant identity; there is no login on this path.
threats.mitigation: UUID tokens; distribute links only on the ethics-approved channel; complete campaigns promptly; treat link lists like credentials.

data.name: Researcher / administrator
data.description: Signs in with Firebase Auth. Access gated by the admin custom claim.

threats.title: Administrator session hijack
threats.description: Phishing or password reuse against the researcher Google/Firebase account yields dashboard access.
threats.mitigation: Firebase Auth plus admin custom claim on the client and on every callable; few admin users; MFA.

data.name:
Phishing Awareness
Simulator
data.description: Web app on Firebase Hosting, Python Cloud Functions, and Firestore. Delivers simulated phishing, records outcomes, quiz, and aggregate reporting.

threats.title: Public function flooding
threats.description: Unauthenticated /api/scenario, /api/event, and /api/quiz-batch can be flooded, stalling a live campaign or raising Blaze-plan cost.
threats.mitigation: Keep campaign URLs unlisted; Cloud quotas; complete campaigns when finished. No app-level rate limit yet.

threats.title: Fake login captures real passwords
threats.description: A participant may type a real campus password into the simulated portal.
threats.mitigation: Browser discards typed values; server records only that a submission occurred; isolated from Eduvos IdP.

threats.title: Unapproved or harmful scenario published
threats.description: A rogue or rushed admin could publish offensive, illegally targeted, or too-realistic copy (real staff names, live campus URLs).
threats.mitigation: Drafts start as pending_review; approve_scenario required for live and quiz_live; review checklist.

data.name:
Google Cloud /
Firebase
data.description: Hosting, Auth, Functions, Firestore. Platform identity and encryption at rest.
data.reasonOutOfScope: Platform operated by Google; in-scope is application config and data only.

data.name: Tokenised scenario / quiz (HTTPS)
data.description: Participant opens /s.html?t=TOKEN or /quiz.html. Crosses TB1 and TB4.

threats.title: Token leakage discloses outcome and debrief
threats.description: A leaked token lets a third party fetch debrief content and the recorded outcome for that assignment.
threats.mitigation: Withhold indicators until debrief; client-denied assignment collection; short campaign windows.

threats.title: Cleartext interception of study traffic
threats.description: Participant and admin traffic crosses the public internet.
threats.mitigation: Firebase Hosting enforces HTTPS; HSTS, X-Frame-Options DENY, nosniff, no-referrer in firebase.json.

data.name: Admin sign-in and dashboard (HTTPS)
data.description: Firebase Auth session plus admin claim. Crosses TB2 and TB4.

threats.title: Elevation via admin custom claim or Admin SDK
threats.description: The admin claim is minted by set_admin.py / service account. A leaked key or mis-granted claim exposes approve, launch, and function-accessible collections.
threats.mitigation: Never commit service accounts; unique strong passwords; MFA; review Cloud Audit logs.

data.name: Managed cloud services
data.description: Hosting, callable/HTTP functions, Firestore Admin SDK. Crosses TB3 inside GCP.

data.name:
P2 Event
recording
data.description: POST /api/event {token, type}. Never stores submitted form input. Ranked outcomes.

threats.title: Unauthenticated POST /api/event with a leaked token
threats.description: A token holder can send clicked, submitted, or reported and distort study integrity. Outcome ranking limits some replay, but does not stop a valid token from choosing an action.
threats.mitigation: Ranked outcomes; closed campaigns stop recording; no client writes to aggregates. Review aggregate anomalies; do not treat results as an invigilated exam.

threats.title: Fake login captures real passwords
threats.description: A participant may type a real campus password into the simulated portal.
threats.mitigation: Browser discards typed values; server records only that a submission occurred; isolated from Eduvos IdP.

threats.title: Public function flooding
threats.description: Unauthenticated /api/scenario, /api/event, and /api/quiz-batch can be flooded, stalling a live campaign or raising Blaze-plan cost.
threats.mitigation: Keep campaign URLs unlisted; Cloud quotas; complete campaigns when finished. No app-level rate limit yet.

data.name: P3 Debrief
data.description: GET /api/debrief?t= TOKEN. Returns indicators, tips, and recorded outcome after a response.

threats.title: Token leakage discloses outcome and debrief
threats.description: A leaked token lets a third party fetch debrief content and the recorded outcome for that assignment.
threats.mitigation: Withhold indicators until debrief; client-denied assignment collection; short campaign windows.

data.name: P4 Quiz batch
data.description: GET /api/quiz-batch. Mixed live approved emails. Public quiz_live reads also exist.

threats.title: Quiz batch discloses correct phishing/legit labels
threats.description: GET /api/quiz-batch and public quiz_live reads include isPhishing so the client can score. A learner can read the JSON and see answers.
threats.mitigation: Treat the quiz as practice not a secret exam. Optional later hardening: score on the server and withhold isPhishing until after the answer.

threats.title: Learner tampers with self-score via API labels
threats.description: Because labels ship with the batch, quiz scores are not trustworthy as an exam result. Campaign behavioural data remains separate.
threats.mitigation: Do not use quiz scores as the sole evaluation measure; keep campaign token path for behaviour.

threats.title: Public function flooding
threats.description: Unauthenticated /api/scenario, /api/event, and /api/quiz-batch can be flooded, stalling a live campaign or raising Blaze-plan cost.
threats.mitigation: Keep campaign URLs unlisted; Cloud quotas; complete campaigns when finished. No app-level rate limit yet.

data.name:
P6 Admin
dashboard
data.description: Static Hosting pages. requireAdmin(). Reads aggregates, daily_stats, scenarios, campaigns only.

threats.title: Administrator session hijack
threats.description: Phishing or password reuse against the researcher Google/Firebase account yields dashboard access.
threats.mitigation: Firebase Auth plus admin custom claim on the client and on every callable; few admin users; MFA.

threats.title: Researcher CSV export stored on an unmanaged device
threats.description: Aggregate exports can still re-identify people in a tiny cohort if stored unsafely.
threats.mitigation: Aggregate-only dashboard; no export of tiny groups; approved institutional storage; 5-year retention per ethics.

data.name: DS1 assignments
data.description: Token, campaign, role, outcome. Client read/write denied.

threats.title: Future Firestore rules allow client reads of events or assignments
threats.description: A rules edit could break the ethics promise that raw outcomes are never readable in the browser.
threats.mitigation: Default deny; emulator tests before deploy; no dashboard feature that reads assignments client-side.

data.name: DS2 events
data.description: Raw event log (token, type, ts). Client denied.

threats.title: Future Firestore rules allow client reads of events or assignments
threats.description: A rules edit could break the ethics promise that raw outcomes are never readable in the browser.
threats.mitigation: Default deny; emulator tests before deploy; no dashboard feature that reads assignments client-side.

threats.title: Weak forensic attribution of participant actions
threats.description: Anonymised codes mean researchers cannot prove which natural person produced an outcome. Server event timestamps support study accountability only.
threats.mitigation: Accepted by ethics design. Admin createdBy/approvedBy UIDs cover researcher actions in part.
